div.head: I Em 5
div.ab: Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop bete Godes hus on his agnum ⁊ eac þone cyning myngige, ðæt ealle Godes cyrcan syn wel behweorfene, swa us mucel þearf is.
Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop béte Godes hus on his agenum ⁊ eac þone cyningc minegige, þæt ealle Godes circan syn wel behworfene, swa us micel þearf is.
Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop bete Godes hus on his agnum ⁊ eac ðone cyning myndgige, þæt ealle Godes cyrcan syn wel behwofene, swa us micel ðearf his.
Amplius diximus, ut omnis episcopus reficiat Dei domos in suo proprio et regem admoneat, ut omnes ecclesie Dei sint bene parate, sicut magnum nobis opus est.
[Be cyricena gebetunge.] [Ld] Eac we gecwædon, þæt ælc biscop béte Godes hus on his agenum, ⁊ eac þone cyningc minegige, þæt ealle Godes circan syn wel behworfene, swa us micel þearf is.

Likewise we have ordained that every bishop shall restore the houses of God on his own property, and also exhort the king that all God's churches be well put in order, as we have much need [that they be].

(Über Instandhaltung der Kirchen. Ld) Ferner bestimmten wir, dass jeder Bischof auf seinem Eigen[gut] die Gotteshäuser gut in Stand halte und auch den König ermahne, dass alle Gotteskirchen wohl versehen seien, wie uns höchst nöthig ist.

(Of the upkeep of churches. Ld) Further we determined that every bishop keep the houses of God in good repair on his own [property] and also admonish the king that all God's churches be well provided for, as is most needful for us.
